title: lane-stop-gate telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the autonomy plugin's deterministic lane-stop gate (Stop hook). Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "lane-stop-gate". Evolves additive-only. Only the gate's three EVALUATED outcomes emit (an opted-in lane, a true Stop event, payload parsed); the default-off and fail-open exits are silent. The payload is a closed fixed vocabulary by design: it NEVER carries the sentinel token value, the marker path, the session cwd, or the branch name.

outcome.description: Evaluated gate outcome: "completion-signaled" (legitimate stop, allowed silently; envelope status ok) | "nudged" (first stop attempt without a completion signal, blocked once with the re-injected self-check; envelope status blocked) | "stopped-after-nudge" (lane stopped again without signaling — treated as a genuine down/stuck lane, allowed with the operator notification; envelope status ok).

signal.description: Which completion channel authorized the stop: "sentinel" (token alone on its own line in the final message) | "marker" (configured marker file exists) | "none" (no signal — the nudged and stopped-after-nudge outcomes). The channel kind only, never the configured token or path.
